meta.title: Daily token usage
meta.description: Shows daily token usage with a per-model breakdown, counted from the session logs on this machine. A sidebar-foot button shows today's total and pops a compact 14-day panel. Settings gains a Usage statistics page in the reference dashboard layout: a five-cell summary strip (total, peak day, today, current and longest daily streaks), a full-year GitHub-style token activity heatmap with daily/weekly/cumulative modes, a 7/30-day range switch, and a smooth per-model daily trend chart with hover detail, plus a per-route input/output/cache/calls/share table. Opening a surface makes one authenticated request to /api/token-usage-dashboard/summary; usage is read from local session logs only and nothing is sent elsewhere.
